Convert a fit to gap_check's equation-table representation (S7 generic)

Source: R/flode_classes.R
as_rating_table.Rd

Turns a fitted FlodeRating into the equation table (lower_level, upper_level, C, a, n, one row per limb) that expand_rating_table(), the gap-checking functions, compare_ratings() and apply_rating_inverse() work with. Replaces fitted_rating_to_table().

There is a method for FlodeRating only. A FlodeSegmentedRating is one joint model with no independent limbs, so it has no table form; a FlodeRatingTable is already one.

Usage

as_rating_table(fit, ...)

Arguments

fit

A FlodeRating.

...

Passed to the class-specific method; none are used.

Value

A FlodeRatingTable with status "independently_fitted" and no previous version, ready for expand_rating_table(). A doubtful column, if flag_extrapolated_limbs() has added one, is kept.

See also

rating_limbs() for the same equations as a plain table without the class.

Examples

set.seed(1)
stage_m <- seq(0.5, 2.5, by = 0.05)
discharge_cms <- 5 * stage_m^1.6 + rnorm(length(stage_m), sd = 0.02)
fit <- rate_optimise(discharge_cms, stage_m)

rating_table <- as_rating_table(fit)
rating_table
#> <FlodeRatingTable> 1 limb(s), origin: independently_fitted, lifecycle: draft
#>   converged: not assessed (no optimiser record for this rating)
#>   valid: yes
#>    lower_level upper_level        C            a        n
#>          <num>       <num>    <num>        <num>    <num>
#> 1:         0.5         2.5 4.991305 -0.001447794 1.600899
apply_rating(rating_table, c(0.8, 1.6, 2.4))
#>    stage discharge extrapolated         support
#>    <num>     <num>       <lgcl>          <char>
#> 1:   0.8  3.502096        FALSE model_supported
#> 2:   1.6 10.607630        FALSE model_supported
#> 3:   2.4 20.291449        FALSE model_supported
